provider_component_id.description: component_id of the component-contract.v1.schema.json record that provides the interface.

interface_name.description: Matches the name field of one entry in the provider component's provided_interfaces array.

consumer_component_id.description: component_id of the component that consumes provider_component_id's interface_name via its own required_interfaces.

consumer_program_id.description: 07 SS2.3: Provided Interface change is reverse-looked-up via ReuseLink to scan impact on other Programs in the same System (Cross-Program Impact Scan). One ReuseLink record is one provider-interface-to-consumer edge; the reverse index is the set of ReuseLink records sharing a provider_component_id/interface_name pair.
